prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Checking Desktop Compatibility", "Verifying display permissions and graphics renderer for desktop companion overlay.", "Display permissions checked", "Initializing overlay engine"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active! Right-click to open controls, drag to move, or double-click to chat.", "Quick Controls: Right-click pet for menu | Drag pet anywhere on screen | Double-click to talk"]
2: ["Taking longer than usual? Check your network connection or try signing in again.", "Retry Sign In"]
3: ["Custom Pet Photo Guidance", "Follow these quick recommendations for best 3D pet rendering results.", "Use clear lighting and avoid blur", "Include single pet centered in frame", "Continue to Upload"]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Select how active or quiet you want your desktop companion to be during your work day.", "Relaxed Companion | Interactive Playmate | Productive Assistant"]
5: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "Building 3D model, generating behaviors, and preparing desktop overlay.", "Step 2 of 3: Rendering pet animations"]
6: ["Tip: You can change your pet's name anytime in settings later!", "Popular names: Barnaby, Pixel, Mocha, Ziggy"]
7: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Create or access your account so your pet state and preferences stay synced.", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Apple"]
8: ["Unlocked Title: Pioneer Pet Parent"]
9: ["Preview Pet Playstyles", "See how different companions behave on your desktop before choosing your journey.", "Chill Pet: Sits calmly in your taskbar", "Active Pet: Wanders across screen and plays", "Select My Path"]
